quote: The older I grow the more I distrust the familiar doctrine that age brings wisdom.
author: H. L. Mencken

quote: Wisdom doesn't necessarily come with age. Sometimes age just shows up all by itself.
author: Tom Wilson

quote: The mind that is wise mourns less for what age takes away than what it leaves behind.
author: William Wordsworth

author: Bo Bennett

quote: The wisdom of age: don't stop walking.
author: Mason Cooley

quote: The philosophies of one age have become the absurdities of the next, and the foolishness of yesterday has become the wisdom of tomorrow.
author: William Osler

quote: Not by age but by capacity is wisdom acquired.
author: Plautus

quote: I'm very accepting with my age. It's like notches on your belt: experience, wisdom, and a different kind of beauty. There comes a day when you've become comfortable in your skin.

quote: Age does not bring you wisdom, age brings you wrinkles.

quote: This is the highest wisdom that I own freedom and life are earned by those alone who conquer them each day anew.
author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quote: Better mad with the rest of the world than wise alone.
author: Baltasar Gracian

quote: Wisdom is not wisdom when it is derived from books alone.

quote: It is great folly to wish to be wise all alone.

quote: Wisdom comes alone through suffering.

quote: Wisdom alone is true ambition's aim, wisdom is the source of virtue and of fame obtained with labour, for mankind employed, and then, when most you share it, best enjoyed.
author: Alfred North Whitehead

quote: Of all our possessions, wisdom alone is imortal.
author: Isocrates

author: Mickey Rourke

author: William James

quote: In seeking wisdom thou art wise in imagining that thou hast attained it - thou art a fool.

author: Akhenaton

quote: In youth and beauty, wisdom is but rare!

author: Thomas Jefferson

quote: Beauty makes idiots sad and wise men merry.

author: William Penn

author: Euripides

author: Euripides

author: Buddha

quote: This is the highest wisdom that I own freedom and life are earned by those alone who conquer them each day anew.

author: Buddha

author: Josh Billings

quote: Science gives us knowledge, but only philosophy can give us wisdom.
author: Will Durant

quote: Moderation is the inseparable companion of wisdom, but with it genius has not even a nodding acquaintance.
author: Charles Caleb Colton

quote: All human wisdom is summed up in two words wait and hope.
author: Alexandre Dumas

quote: Wisdom is the abstract of the past, but beauty is the promise of the future.
author: Oliver Wendell Holmes

quote: In complete darkness we are all the same, it is only our knowledge and wisdom that separates us, don't let your eyes deceive you.
author: Janet Jackson

quote: To know how to grow old is the master work of wisdom, and one of the most difficult chapters in the great art of living.
author: Herman Melville

quote: The truest greatness lies in being kind, the truest wisdom in a happy mind.
author: Ella Wheeler Wilcox

quote: Discipline is wisdom and vice versa.
author: M. Scott Peck

quote: Come, come, leave business to idlers, and wisdom to fools: they have need of 'em: wit be my faculty, and pleasure my occupation, and let father Time shake his glass.
author: William Congreve

quote: Doubt is the vestibule through which all must pass before they can enter into the temple of wisdom.
author: Charles Caleb Colton

quote: Music is your own experience, your own thoughts, your wisdom. If you don't live it, it won't come out of your horn. They teach you there's a boundary line to music. But, man, there's no boundary line to art.
author: Charlie Parker

quote: The stupidity of people comes from having an answer for everything. The wisdom of the novel comes from having a question for everything.
author: Milan Kundera

quote: True wisdom is less presuming than folly. The wise man doubteth often, and changeth his mind the fool is obstinate, and doubteth not he knoweth all things but his own ignorance.
author: Akhenaton

quote: That which seems the height of absurdity in one generation often becomes the height of wisdom in another.
author: Adlai E. Stevenson

quote: Central banks don't have divine wisdom. They try to do the best analysis they can and must be prepared to stand or fall by the quality of that analysis.
author: Mary Kay Ash

quote: What makes Superman a hero is not that he has power, but that he has the wisdom and the maturity to use the power wisely. From an acting point of view, that's how I approached the part.
author: Christopher Reeve

quote: Without courage, wisdom bears no fruit.
author: Baltasar Gracian

quote: We have no words for speaking of wisdom to the stupid. He who understands the wise is wise already.
author: Georg C. Lichtenberg

quote: To acquire knowledge, one must study but to acquire wisdom, one must observe.
author: Marilyn vos Savant

quote: Great wisdom is generous petty wisdom is contentious.
author: Zhuangzi

quote: Children also have artistic ability, and there is wisdom in there having it! The more helpless they are, the more instructive are the examples they furnish us and they must be preserved free of corruption from an early age.
author: Paul Klee

quote: Every speaker has a mouth An arrangement rather neat. Sometimes it's filled with wisdom. Sometimes it's filled with feet.
author: Robert Orben

quote: They whom truth and wisdom lead, can gather honey from a weed.
author: William Cowper

quote: I believe we have become paralyzed, paralyzed by our desire to be loved. Now our founding fathers had the wisdom to know that social acceptance and popularity were fleeing, and that this country's principles needed to be rooted in strengths greater than the passions and the emotions of the times.
author: Chris Christie

quote: There is no pain equal to that which two lovers can inflict on one another. This should be made clear to all who contemplate such a union. The avoidance of this pain is the beginning of wisdom, for it is strong enough to contaminate the rest of our lives.
author: Cyril Connolly

quote: Pain makes man think. Thought makes man wise. Wisdom makes life endurable.
author: John Patrick

quote: The wisdom of the wise and the experience of the ages is preserved into perpetuity by a nation's proverbs, fables, folk sayings and quotations.
author: William Feather

quote: It is good even for old men to learn wisdom.
author: Aeschylus

quote: Conventional wisdom on government's role in inequality often has it backwards. Tax reforms have resulted in a more progressive federal income tax government transfer payments have become less progressive.
author: Paul Ryan

quote: They would need to be already wise, in order to love wisdom.
author: Friedrich Schiller

quote: I sought my father in the world of the black musician, because it contained wisdom, experience, sadness and loneliness. I was not ever interested in the music of boys. From my youngest years, I was interested in the music of men.
author: Eric Clapton

quote: The word philosophy sounds high-minded, but it simply means the love of wisdom. If you love something, you don't just read about it you hug it, you mess with it, you play with it, you argue with it.
author: Hugh Jackman

quote: It seems to me that, in every culture, I come across a chapter headed 'Wisdom.' And then I know exactly what is going to follow: 'Vanity of vanities, all is vanity.'
author: Ludwig Wittgenstein

quote: Full of wisdom are the ordinations of fate.
author: Friedrich Schiller

quote: If I am fool, it is, at least, a doubting one and I envy no one the certainty of his self-approved wisdom.
author: George Byron

quote: Who knows for what we live, and struggle, and die? Wise men write many books, in words too hard to understand. But this, the purpose of our lives, the end of all our struggle, is beyond all human wisdom.
author: Alan Paton

quote: People always blame the girl she should have said no. A monosyllable, but conventional wisdom has always been that boys can't manage it.
author: Anna Quindlen

quote: Life is the only real counselor wisdom unfiltered through personal experience does not become a part of the moral tissue.
author: Edith Wharton

quote: Government is a contrivance of human wisdom to provide for human wants. People have the right to expect that these wants will be provided for by this wisdom.
author: Jimmy Carter

quote: It is essential to employ, trust, and reward those whose perspective, ability, and judgment are radically different from yours. It is also rare, for it requires uncommon humility, tolerance, and wisdom.
author: Dee Hock

quote: The pine stays green in winter... wisdom in hardship.
author: Norman Douglas

quote: Mixing one's wines may be a mistake, but old and new wisdom mix admirably.
author: Bertolt Brecht

quote: If we continue to develop our technology without wisdom or prudence, our servant may prove to be our executioner.
author: Omar N. Bradley

quote: Our wisdom comes from our experience, and our experience comes from our foolishness.
author: Sacha Guitry

quote: A man may learn wisdom even from a foe.
author: Aristophanes

quote: For all my education, accomplishments, and so called 'wisdom'... I can't fathom my own heart.
author: Michael Caine

quote: I actually don't think that I'm that much smarter than anybody else. It's just that I frequently just seem to know what to do, and I think that's wisdom.
author: Benjamin Carson

quote: Novels are the Socratic dialogues of our time. Practical wisdom fled from school wisdom into this liberal form.
author: Karl Wilhelm Friedrich Schlegel

quote: Men who know themselves are no longer fools. They stand on the threshold of the door of Wisdom.
author: Havelock Ellis

quote: Kindness is wisdom.
author: Philip James Bailey

quote: Some of the best lessons we ever learn are learned from past mistakes. The error of the past is the wisdom and success of the future.
author: Dale Turner

quote: Experience comprises illusions lost, rather than wisdom gained.
author: Joseph Roux

quote: I don't think you can come into your wisdom until you have made mistakes on your own skin and felt them in reality of your own life.
author: Elizabeth Gilbert

quote: In the frank expression of conflicting opinions lies the greatest promise of wisdom in governmental action.
author: Louis D. Brandeis

quote: I keep my friends as misers do their treasure, because, of all the things granted us by wisdom, none is greater or better than friendship.
author: Pietro Aretino

quote: I don't turn to greeting cards for wisdom and advice, but they are a fine reflection of the general drift of the culture.
author: Susan Orlean

quote: I'm married. My wife, Stella - a beautiful woman. She's brought a lot of peace to my life, a lot of wisdom.
author: Anthony Hopkins

quote: Morality comes with the sad wisdom of age, when the sense of curiosity has withered.
author: Graham Greene

quote: Every day, every birthday candle I blow out, every penny I throw over my shoulder in a wishing well, every time my daughter says, 'Let's make a wish on a star,' there's one thing I wish for: wisdom.
author: Rene Russo

quote: Great wisdom is generous petty wisdom is contentious. Great speech is impassioned, small speech cantankerous.
author: Zhuang Zi

quote: Logic is the beginning of wisdom, not the end.
author: Leonard Nimoy

quote: Whenever you argue with another wiser than yourself in order that others may admire your wisdom, they will discover your ignorance.
author: Saadi

quote: The more I work with the body, keeping my assumptions in a temporary state of reservation, the more I appreciate and sympathize with a given disease. The body no longer appears as a sick or irrational demon, but as a process with its own inner logic and wisdom.
author: George MacDonald

quote: Wisdom is not attained by years, but by ability.
author: Plautus

quote: Not by age but by capacity is wisdom acquired.
author: Plautus

quote: Around '93, '94, the conventional wisdom about the Internet was that it was a toy for academics and researchers. So it was very, very underestimated for about two years.
author: Marc Andreessen

quote: Lessons of wisdom have the most power over us when they capture the heart through the groundwork of a story, which engages the passions.
author: Laurence Sterne

quote: Sciences may be learned by rote, but wisdom not.
author: Laurence Sterne

quote: Experiences are savings which a miser puts aside. Wisdom is an inheritance which a wastrel cannot exhaust.
author: Karl Kraus

quote: Knowledge shrinks as wisdom grows.
author: Alfred North Whitehead

quote: Many spiritual teachers - in Buddhism, in Islam - have talked about first-hand experience of the world as an important part of the path to wisdom, to enlightenment.
author: Bell Hooks

quote: Knowledge is going to make you stronger. Knowledge is going to let you control your life. Knowledge is going to give you the wisdom to teach their children. Knowledge is the thing that makes you smile in the face of disaster.
author: Avery Brooks

quote: Wisdom and understanding can only become the possession of individual men by travelling the old road of observation, attention, perseverance, and industry.
author: Samuel Smiles

quote: To build a great company, which is a CEO's job, sometimes you have to stand up against conventional wisdom.
author: Carly Fiorina

quote: Age is a terrible avenger. The lessons of life give you so much to work with, but by the time you've got all this great wisdom, you don't get to be young anymore.
author: Elizabeth Wurtzel

quote: It is almost everywhere the case that soon after it is begotten the greater part of human wisdom is laid to rest in repositories.
author: Georg C. Lichtenberg

quote: Wisdom oft times consists of knowing what to do next.
author: Herbert Hoover

quote: Wisdom consists not so much in knowing what to do in the ultimate as knowing what to do next.
author: Herbert Hoover

quote: All free governments are managed by the combined wisdom and folly of the people.
author: James A. Garfield

quote: No one ever found wisdom without also being a fool. Writers, alas, have to be fools in public, while the rest of the human race can cover its tracks.
author: Erica Jong

quote: My mother is a great source of advice and wisdom and consolation for me.
author: Katherine Heigl

quote: Wisdom alone is true ambition's aim, wisdom is the source of virtue and of fame obtained with labour, for mankind employed, and then, when most you share it, best enjoyed.
author: Alfred North Whitehead

quote: Wisdom consists of the anticipation of consequences.
author: Norman Cousins

quote: Sometimes one likes foolish people for their folly, better than wise people for their wisdom.
author: Elizabeth Gaskell

quote: I'm not wise, but the beginning of wisdom is there it's like relaxing into - and an acceptance of - things.
author: Tina Turner

quote: Wisdom is knowing when you can't be wise.
author: Paul Engle

quote: The left has come to regard common sense - the traditional wisdom and folkways of the community - as an obstacle to progress and enlightenment.
author: Christopher Lasch

quote: I always see where I didn't do things the right way. I only see the heavy lifting. That's a bit of my wisdom, if you want to call it that.
author: Vera Wang

quote: Saudi Arabia is a puritanical state that claims a monopoly of wisdom and virtue.
author: James Buchan

quote: Purity engenders Wisdom, Passion avarice, and Ignorance folly, infatuation and darkness.
author: Cyril Connolly

quote: Vanity can easily overtake wisdom. It usually overtakes common sense.
author: Julian Casablancas

quote: If you have the guts to keep making mistakes, your wisdom and intelligence leap forward with huge momentum.
author: Holly Near

quote: After 25-plus years as a lawyer, prosecutor, and defense attorney, I have developed a deep appreciation for both the wisdom of the law and the role that jurists play in framing the rights and responsibilities that define our society.
author: Eliot Spitzer

quote: I'll come to you with gifts of knowledge, wisdom and truth.
author: Barry White

quote: Wisdom is nothing but a preparation of the soul, a capacity, a secret art of thinking, feeling and breathing thoughts of unity at every moment of life.
author: Herman Hesse

quote: Now that I am sixty, I see why the idea of elder wisdom has passed from currency.
author: John Updike

quote: The Founding Fathers in their wisdom decided that children were an unnatural strain on parents. So they provided jails called schools, equipped with tortures called an education.
author: John Updike

quote: Wisdom and deep intelligence require an honest appreciation of mystery.
author: Thomas Moore

quote: Now our founding fathers had the wisdom to know that social acceptance and popularity were fleeing, and that this country's principles needed to be rooted in strengths greater than the passions and the emotions of the times.
author: Chris Christie

quote: I acknowledge the privilege of being alive in a human body at this moment, endowed with senses, memories, emotions, thoughts, and the space of mind in its wisdom aspect.
author: Alex Grey

quote: The art of storytelling is reaching its end because the epic side of truth, wisdom, is dying out.
author: Walter Benjamin

quote: It has become part of the accepted wisdom to say that the twentieth century was the century of physics and the twenty-first century will be the century of biology.
author: Freeman Dyson

quote: The novelist teaches the reader to comprehend the world as a question. There is wisdom and tolerance in that attitude. In a world built on sacrosanct certainties the novel is dead.
author: Milan Kundera

quote: If you have a vaccine or an antidote that people can benefit from, you're not going to want to keep it to yourself. You're going to want to spread that wisdom or whatever to as many people as you can, so everybody can benefit from it.
author: will.i.am

quote: I have learned throughout my life as a composer chiefly through my mistakes and pursuits of false assumptions, not by my exposure to founts of wisdom and knowledge.
author: Igor Stravinsky

quote: Community organizing is all about building grassroots support. It's about identifying the people around you with whom you can create a common, passionate cause. And it's about ignoring the conventional wisdom of company politics and instead playing the game by very different rules.
author: Tom Peters

quote: The most excellent and divine counsel, the best and most profitable advertisement of all others, but the least practiced, is to study and learn how to know ourselves. This is the foundation of wisdom and the highway to whatever is good.
author: Pierre Charron

quote: Spending two years on my uncle's ranch in Montana as a young man gave me the wisdom and the thrust to do westerns.
author: Robert Duvall

quote: It's received wisdom that the English are uniquely child-unfriendly.
author: Julie Burchill

quote: Silence and reserve will give anyone a reputation for wisdom.
author: Myrtle Reed

quote: He was gifted with the sly, sharp instinct for self-preservation that passes for wisdom among the rich.
author: Evelyn Waugh

quote: The wisdom and experience of older people is a resource of inestimable worth. Recognizing and treasuring the contributions of older people is essential to the long-term flourishing of any society.
author: Daisaku Ikeda

quote: History is filled with tragic examples of wars that result from diplomatic impasse. Whether in our local communities or in international relations, the skillful use of our communicative capacities to negotiate and resolve differences is the first evidence of human wisdom.
author: Daisaku Ikeda

quote: I'm very accepting with my age. It's like notches on your belt: experience, wisdom, and a different kind of beauty. There comes a day when you've become comfortable in your skin.
author: Zoe Saldana

quote: There is a trade off - as you grow older you gain wisdom but you lose spontaneity.
author: Kenny Rogers

quote: One part of wisdom is knowing what you don't need anymore and letting it go.
author: Jane Fonda

quote: It may almost be a question whether such wisdom as many of us have in our mature years has not come from the dying out of the power of temptation, rather than as the results of thought and resolution.
author: Anthony Trollope

quote: The weak have remedies, the wise have joys superior wisdom is superior bliss.
author: Edward Young

quote: The clouds may drop down titles and estates, and wealth may seek us, but wisdom must be sought.
author: Edward Young

quote: In complete darkness, it is only knowledge and wisdom that separates us.
author: Janet Jackson

quote: We all admire the wisdom of people who come to us for advice.
author: Arthur Helps

quote: When I was at drama school, I wanted to change the world, and thought I had some great wisdom to impart to people about humanity. Now that I'm older, I know enough to realise that I know nothing at all.
author: Michael Sheen

quote: The plan was criticized by some retired military officers embedded in TV studios. But with every advance by our coalition forces, the wisdom of that plan becomes more apparent.
author: Dick Cheney

quote: Many people have their reputations as reporters and analysts because they are on television, batting around conventional wisdom. A lot of these people have never reported a story.
author: Bob Woodward

quote: Even when you have doubts, take that step. Take chances. Mistakes are never a failure - they can be turned into wisdom.
author: Cat Cora

quote: In particular, for younger researchers on whom the future of mankind may depend. We believe that they are working with all the scientific wisdom at their disposal for the preservation of the inheritance of the earth and for the lasting survival of mankind.
author: Kenichi Fukui

quote: Economists often like startling theorems, results which seem to run counter to conventional wisdom.
author: Joseph Stiglitz

quote: Never say never, but the thought of electively cutting oneself is beyond my grasp, and I also object to it politically. Denying the lines on our faces makes a comment about age and wisdom I don't care to make.
author: Debra Winger

quote: If to live is to progress, if you are lucky, from foolishness to wisdom, then to write novels is to broadcast the various stages of your foolishness.
author: Jane Smiley

quote: Practical wisdom is only to be learned in the school of experience. Precepts and instruction are useful so far as they go, but, without the discipline of real life, they remain of the nature of theory only.
author: Samuel Smiles

quote: The experience gathered from books, though often valuable, is but the nature of learning whereas the experience gained from actual life is one of the nature of wisdom.
author: Samuel Smiles

quote: It is astonishing what force, purity, and wisdom it requires for a human being to keep clear of falsehoods.
author: Margaret Fuller

quote: Evil can be a teacher, if you look at the wisdom of its negative power.
author: Tom Brown, Jr.

quote: Mistakes are the usual bridge between inexperience and wisdom.
author: Phyllis Theroux

quote: I don't think I really have any wisdom. Stay out of trouble. Good luck. Stay away from women because they will burn you, haha.
author: Jason Aldean

quote: Has fortune dealt you some bad cards. Then let wisdom make you a good gamester.
author: Francis Quarles

quote: The greatest wisdom is to realize one's lack of it.
author: Constantin Stanislavski

quote: It's very hard to know what wisdom is.
author: James Hillman

quote: As a parent and a citizen, I'll take a Bill Gates (or Warren Buffett) over Steve Jobs every time. If we must have billionaires, better they should ignore Jobs's example and instead embrace the morality and wisdom of the great industrialist-philanthropist Andrew Carnegie.
author: Eric Alterman

quote: Never accept ultimatums, conventional wisdom, or absolutes.
author: Christopher Reeve

quote: I always told, Sandra Bullock was my student when she was younger, I always told her it's important that we hold on to our insecurity, the wisdom of insecurity.
author: Sally Kirkland

quote: Contemplation and wisdom are highest achievements and man is not totally at home with them.
author: Gabriel Marcel

quote: The wisdom of crowds works when the crowd is choosing the price of an ox, when there's a single numeric average. But if it's a design or something that matters, the decision is made by committee, and that's crap. You want people and groups who are able to think thoughts before they share.
author: Jaron Lanier

quote: There is no knowledge, no light, no wisdom that you are in possession of, but what you have received it from some source.
author: Brigham Young

quote: The wisdom of the wise, and the experience of ages, may be preserved by quotation.
author: Isaac D'Israeli

quote: Putting is like wisdom - partly a natural gift and partly the accumulation of experience.
author: Arnold Palmer

quote: I am a poor student sitting at the feet of giants, yearning for their wisdom and begging for lessons that might one day make me a complete artist, so that if all goes well, I may one day sit beside them.
author: Rod Taylor

quote: Humility is the only true wisdom by which we prepare our minds for all the possible changes of life.
author: George Arliss

quote: Of all our possessions, wisdom alone is imortal.
author: Isocrates

quote: Wisdom is the knowledge of good and evil, not the strength to choose between the two.
author: John Cheever

quote: I have sympathy for young people, for their growing pains, but I balk when these growing pains are pushed into the foreground, when you make these young people the only vehicles of life's wisdom.
author: Wislawa Szymborska

quote: When you're used to being prepared to reject conventional wisdom, it leaves you open to learn more.
author: Mayim Bialik

quote: No man is the wiser for his learning it may administer matter to work in, or objects to work upon but wit and wisdom are born with a man.
author: John Selden

quote: A great memory is never made synonymous with wisdom, any more than a dictionary would be called a treatise.
author: John Henry Newman

quote: Although it has been said by men of more wit than wisdom, and perhaps more malice than either, that women are naturally incapable of acting prudently, or that they are necessarily determined to folly, I must by no means grant it.
author: Mary Astell

quote: Unhappy is that Grandeur which makes us too great to be good and that Wit which sets us at a distance from true Wisdom.
author: Mary Astell

quote: Imagination allows us to escape the predictable. It enables us to reply to the common wisdom that we cannot soar by saying, 'Just watch!'
author: Bill Bradley

quote: Our bodies are at once the receiving and transmitting stations for life itself. It is the highest wisdom to recognize this fact and train our bodies to render them sensitive and responsive to nature. art and religion.
author: Ruth St. Denis

quote: Books are the ever burning lamps of accumulated wisdom.
author: George William Curtis

quote: My past is my wisdom to use today... my future is my wisdom yet to experience. Be in the present because that is where life resides.
author: Gene Oliver

quote: However great an evil immorality may be, we must not forget that it is not without its beneficial consequences. It is only through extremes that men can arrive at the middle path of wisdom and virtue.
author: Wilhelm von Humboldt

quote: Our experience is composed rather of illusions that of wisdom acquired.
author: Joseph Roux

quote: There is as much wisdom in listening as there is in speaking - and that goes for all relationships, not just romantic ones.
author: Daniel Dae Kim

quote: The greater the step forward in knowledge, the greater is the one taken backward in search of wisdom.
author: Stephen Gardiner

quote: Your art kind of changes as you get older, by nature of the fact that you're hopefully gaining wisdom and you're starting to watch things with a better overview.
author: Sheryl Crow

quote: Wisdom not only gets, but once got, retains.
author: Francis Quarles

quote: Normally street children are shown in terms of the tragedy of their lives - which is true - but there's also another dimension: their wisdom, dignity and enormous capacity for survival.
author: Henning Mankell

quote: Man is wise and constantly in quest of more wisdom but the ultimate wisdom, which deals with beginnings, remains locked in a seed. There it lies, the simplest fact of the universe and at the same time the one which calls forth faith rather than reason.
author: Hal Borland

quote: What is all wisdom save a collection of platitudes?
author: Norman Douglas

quote: The sublimity of wisdom is to do those things living, which are to be desired when dying.
author: Norman Douglas

quote: As great as Ed is, the wisdom out here is that he can't carry a movie. They'll pay him $3 million to be the second banana in Julia Roberts things. But they won't put up $3 million for an Ed Harris movie.
author: George A. Romero

quote: We learned in World War II that no single nation holds a monopoly on wisdom, morality or right to power, but that we must fight for the weak and promote democracy.
author: Joe Baca

quote: A wholesome oblivion of one's neighbours is the beginning of wisdom.
author: Richard Le Gallienne

quote: Authority without wisdom is like a heavy ax without an edge, fitter to bruise than polish.
author: Anne Bradstreet

quote: I've always shied away from conventional wisdom, though I know the power of it.
author: Peter Jennings

quote: As I visited the various neighborhoods in the campaign, I learned fast that it's a mistake to think that all of the wisdom and possible solutions to our problems are available only in this building.
author: Jane Byrne

quote: One of the most beautiful passages of Rousseau is that in the sixth book of Confessions, where he describes the awakening in him of the literary sense. Of such wisdom, the poetic passion, the desire of beauty, the love of art for its own sake, has most.
author: Walter Pater

quote: You know how people always talk about how vision is the key to entrepreneurship and perseverance and really seeing what other people don't see? We can actually redeem a fair amount of that folk wisdom.
author: Eric Ries

quote: True wisdom listens more, talks less and can get along with all types of people.
author: Kiana Tom

quote: Age does not bring you wisdom, age brings you wrinkles.
author: Estelle Getty

quote: We simply can no longer afford to deny the full potential of one half of the population. The world needs to tap into the talent and wisdom of women. Whether the issue is food security, economic recovery, health, or peace and security, the participation of women is needed now more than ever.
author: Michelle Bachelet

quote: Someday in the distant cyborg future, when our internal and external memories fully merge, we may come to possess infinite knowledge. But that's not the same thing as wisdom.
author: Joshua Foer

quote: Women's strength, women's industry, women's wisdom are humankind's greatest untapped resource. The challenge then for U.N. Women is to show our diverse constituencies how this resource can be effectively tapped in ways that benefit us all.
author: Michelle Bachelet

quote: We all have within us a deep wisdom, but sometimes we don't know we have it.
author: Shakti Gawain

quote: We live in a culture that doesn't acknowledge or validate human intuition and doesn't encourage us to rely on our intuitive wisdom.
author: Shakti Gawain

quote: The thing that we possess, that machines don't, is the ability to exhibit wisdom.
author: Herbie Hancock

quote: Without wisdom, the future has no meaning, no valuable purpose.
author: Herbie Hancock

quote: You can practice to attain knowledge, but you can't practice to attain wisdom.
author: Herbie Hancock

quote: Wisdom is not acquired save as the result of investigation.
author: Sara Teasdale

quote: There was endless action - not just football, but sailboats, tennis and other things: movement. There was endless talk - the ambassador at the head of the table laying out the prevailing wisdom, but everyone else weighing in with their opinions and taking part.
author: Charles Spalding

quote: A man of strength and wisdom, John Paul became an inspiration to generations of both Catholics and non-Catholics throughout the world by encouraging freedom, promoting peace and respecting all faiths.
author: Greg Walden

quote: Spend time reflecting on your emotional and physical existence and how that applies to the voice. You have to apply that wisdom and experience when you sing - it's what comes through.
author: K. D. Lang

quote: My government, you can be assured, will be less focused on personalities. It is about treating people with respect. I think complaining about the community not being able to see the wisdom of our ideas is the wrong approach.
author: Jay Weatherill

quote: Education makes us more stupid than the brutes. A thousand voices call to us on every hand, but our ears are stopped with wisdom.
author: Jean Giraudoux

quote: The beginning of wisdom is to desire it.
author: Solomon Ibn Gabirol

quote: The first point of wisdom is to discern that which is false the second, to know that which is true.
author: Lactantius

quote: The wisdom acquired with the passage of time is a useless gift unless you share it.
author: Esther Williams

quote: Even wisdom has to yield to self-interest.
author: Pindar

quote: I feel increasingly like age is very irrelevant. Quite often, cynicism is confused with wisdom, and my scorn is confused with a knowing, which I don't have.
author: Laura Marling

quote: My mom calls me an older soul because, growing up, she taught me stuff real early. Now I spend most of my time chasing wisdom, chasing understanding.
author: Ray Lewis

quote: The marvel of the Bhagavad-Gita is its truly beautiful revelation of life's wisdom which enables philosophy to blossom into religion.
author: Herman Hesse

quote: The perceived wisdom is that people do not go in large numbers to black-and-white movies anymore - which is a great shame, but I'd love to make a black-and-white movie one day.
author: Sam Mendes

quote: To suppose more than one supreme Source of infinite wisdom, power, and all perfections, is to assert that there is no supreme Being in existence.
author: Adam Clarke

quote: Clinton is a big personality who has led a big life, and for some of the media conventional wisdom to boil it down to a view that 'all people are really interested in' are a few moments of madness in the Oval Office gets him, the importance of the presidency, and the significance of his life, all wrong.
author: Alastair Campbell

quote: I'm someone who's done the opposite of whatever the received wisdom is, to keep your career going into your 50s.
author: Elizabeth McGovern

quote: Ask Elizabeth is a community of voices, it's not me standing on a podium telling people how to run their lives, it's girls helping each other sharing their wisdom and advice and I create a space for them to do it.
author: Elizabeth Berkley

quote: Peace is a fragile thing. It takes courage to secure it. It takes wisdom to maintain it.
author: Jenny Shipley

quote: I've led a school whose faculty and students examine and discuss and debate every aspect of our law and legal system. And what I've learned most is that no one has a monopoly on truth or wisdom. I've learned that we make progress by listening to each other, across every apparent political or ideological divide.
author: Elena Kagan

quote: We do not sit as a superlegislature to weigh the wisdom of legislation.
author: William O. Douglas

quote: After a gig I always head back to the hotel, remembering granny's words of wisdom. I cancel the late-night pizza and watch the Jonathan Ross show instead.
author: Jimmy Carr

quote: I have no wisdom to share on dating.
author: Rachel Dratch

quote: Every journey that is successful has culs-de-sac and speed bumps. I carry a wisdom gene through my life through the good, the bad, and the ugly.
author: Peter Guber

quote: It is now conventional wisdom that Americans do not care why we went to war in Iraq, that it is enough that the world is better off without Saddam Hussein.
author: Adam Schiff

quote: Genius unrefined resembles a flash of lightning, but wisdom is like the sun.
author: Franz Grillparzer

quote: Conventional wisdom holds that setting a timetable for getting American troops out of Iraq would be a mistake.
author: Nick Clooney

quote: The ultimate wisdom which deals with beginnings, remains locked in a seed. There it lies, the simplest fact of the universe and at the same time the one which calls faith rather than reason.
author: Hal Borland

quote: Theology in general seems to me a substitution of human ingenuity for divine wisdom.
author: Julia Ward Howe

quote: For the subtlest folly proceeds from the subtlest wisdom.
author: John Webster

quote: I do interviews because it's a chance to be myself. I sometimes wonder what I could have to say that would be of any interest. I don't have any great wisdom.
author: Parker Stevenson

quote: This is perhaps the most profound meaning of the book of Job, the best example of wisdom.
author: Paul Ricoeur

quote: Wisdom finds its literary expression in wisdom literature.
author: Paul Ricoeur

quote: It is not from reason that justice springs, but goodness is born of wisdom.
author: Maurice Maeterlinck

quote: Wisdom is keeping a sense of fallibility of all our views and opinions.
author: Gerald Brenan

quote: Analysts may be correct that the presidential election won't primarily turn on entitlements reform, but by choosing Paul Ryan as his running mate, Mitt Romney can, contrary to conventional wisdom, make it a winning issue and lay the foundation for a reform mandate when he wins.
author: David Limbaugh

quote: The key to wisdom is knowing all the right questions.
author: John A. Simone, Sr.

quote: Second, this epic tale allows the audience to actually listen to the Native Americans and receive their wisdom. Spielberg conveys the respect for Native Americans that is normally lacking in Western films.
author: Beau Bridges

author: Ray LaMontagne

quote: Even by common wisdom, there seem to be both people and objects in my dream that are outside myself, but clearly they were created in myself and are part of me, they are mental constructs in my own brain.
author: Ray Kurzweil

quote: When I wrote Living in the Light, I wanted to share about how I live my own life and to encourage people to tap into their own inner wisdom.
author: Shakti Gawain

quote: There is a universal, intelligent, life force that exists within everyone and everything. It resides within each one of use as a deep wisdom, an inner knowing. author: Shakti Gawain

quote: I have no agenda except to be funny. Neither I or the writers profess to offer any worldly wisdom.
author: Julia Louis-Dreyfus

quote: If we can return to a government that the Founders, in their wisdom, envisioned for us, we can return to a government that will allow our economy to thrive again, and our people to live in liberty.
author: Nan Hayworth

author: Chris Robinson

quote: Rich people without wisdom and learning are but sheep with golden fleeces.
author: Solon

quote: Wisdom too often never comes, and so one ought not to reject it merely because it comes late.
author: Felix Frankfurter

quote: Preconceived notions are the locks on the door to wisdom.
author: Merry Browne

quote: It is costly wisdom that is bought by experience.
author: Roger Ascham

quote: We have heeded no wisdom offering guidance.
author: Dora Russell

quote: To think the world therefore a general Bedlam, or place of madmen, and oneself a physician, is the most necessary point of present wisdom: an important imagination, and the way to happiness.
author: Thomas Traherne

author: Arianna Huffington

quote: Pain is the doorway to wisdom and to truth.
author: Keith Miller

quote: I'm not a money manager, but I can tell you what the conventional wisdom is. The younger you are, the more risk you can take on.
author: Maria Bartiromo

quote: Dr. Johnson has said that the chief glory of a country arises from its authors. But then that is only as they are oracles of wisdom unless they teach virtue, they are more worthy of a halter than of the laurel.

quote: I covered my face because they had taken my wisdom teeth out.
author: Josh Brolin

quote: To keep your secret is wisdom to expect others to keep it is folly.
author: William Samuel Johnson

author: Giovanni Pico della Mirandola

quote: But I do think it's important to remember that writers do not have a monopoly of wisdom on their books. They can be wrong about their own books, they can often learn about their own books.

quote: Lord, give us the wisdom to utter words that are gentle and tender, for tomorrow we may have to eat them.
author: Mo Udall

quote: Nobility of spirit has more to do with simplicity than ostentation, wisdom rather than wealth, commitment rather than ambition.
author: Riccardo Muti

quote: In garden arrangement, as in all other kinds of decorative work, one has not only to acquire a knowledge of what to do, but also to gain some wisdom in perceiving what it is well to let alone.
author: Gertrude Jekyll

quote: Every indication of wisdom, taken from the effect, is equally an indication of power to execute what wisdom planned.
author: Thomas Reid

quote: Pessimism is only the name that men of weak nerves give to wisdom.
author: Bernard De Voto

quote: He whose wisdom cannot help him, gets no good from being wise.
author: Quintus Ennius

author: Michael D. Higgins

quote: Words of wisdom are spoken by children at least as often as scientists.
author: James Newman

quote: Where fear is present, wisdom cannot be.
author: Lactantius

quote: Wisdom lies neither in fixity nor in change, but in the dialectic between the two.
author: Octavio Paz

quote: What I lack in energy, I have in wisdom.
author: Marcia Cross

quote: We thought, because we had power, we had wisdom.
author: Stephen Vincent Benet

quote: A monarchy conducted with infinite wisdom and infinite benevolence is the most perfect of all possible governments.
author: Ezra Stiles

quote: In justice to human society it may perhaps be said of almost all the polities and civil institutions in the world, however imperfect, that they have been founded in and carried on with very considerable wisdom.
author: Ezra Stiles

quote: The constitutions of Maryland and New York are founded in higher wisdom.
author: Ezra Stiles

quote: Conventional wisdom notwithstanding, there is no reason either in football or in poetry why the two should not meet in a man's life if he has the weight and cares about the words.

quote: Wisdom and goodness are twin-born, one heart must hold both sisters, never seen apart.
author: William Dean Howells

quote: Doubt the conventional wisdom unless you can verify it with reason and experiment.

quote: What's different now is that while political leaders used to give talking points to talk radio, now talk-radio hosts are giving talking points to political leaders. quote: Books should to one of these fours ends conduce, for wisdom, piety, delight, or use.

quote: Your aim will be knowledge and wisdom, not the reflected glamour of fame.

quote: The most important lesson of New Labour is this: Every time we made progress we did it by challenging the conventional wisdom.
author: Ed Miliband

quote: To know one's self is wisdom, but not to know one's neighbors is genius.

quote: I left school at 16 but I wish I'd gone to university - I think I would have studied English literature. I had a knack for that. But I don't think you have the kind of wisdom at 16 to make that decision.

quote: It is not white hair that engenders wisdom.

quote: All human wisdom works and has worries and grief as reward.
author: Johann Georg Hamann

quote: He read his mind. He's a strange sort of man, isn't he? It's not just the advice and the wisdom that he has.

quote: Remembering is painful, it's difficult, but it can be inspiring and it can give wisdom.

quote: Most things break, including hearts. The lessons of life amount not to wisdom, but to scar tissue and callus.

quote: Losing faith in your own singularity is the start of wisdom, I suppose also the first announcement of death.
author: Peter Conrad

quote: You want people walking away from the conversation with some kernel of wisdom or some kind of impact.
author: Harry Dean Stanton

quote: This age thinks better of a gilded fool Than of a threadbare saint in wisdom's school.
author: Thomas Dekker

quote: The 'wisdom of the crowds' is the most ridiculous statement I've heard in my life. Crowds are dumb.

author: William Whitehead

author: Charles Simmons

author: Wilfred Grenfell

quote: The study of history is the beginning of political wisdom.
author: Jean Bodin

quote: I am not one who was born in the custody of wisdom I am one who is fond of olden times and intense in quest of the sacred knowing of the ancients.

quote: It may be assumed as an axiom that Providence has never gifted any political party with all of political wisdom or blinded it with all of political folly.

quote: Wisdom prepares for the worst, but folly leaves the worst for the day when it comes.
author: Richard Cecil

quote: To comprehend the Wisdom of this Injunction the better, and explain the Duty before us, it should be considered, that Government is the only Means by which human Happiness can be attained.
author: Charles Inglis

quote: Wisdom is a kind of knowledge. It is knowledge of the nature, career, and consequences of human values.
author: Sidney Hook

quote: Memory is not wisdom idiots can by rote repeat volumes. Yet what is wisdom without memory?

quote: I continue to believe, contrary to the given wisdom, that it's more interesting to have an album - or, indeed, an individual song - which has variety rather than homogeneity.
author: Peter Hammill

quote: Be there a will, and wisdom finds a way.
author: George Crabbe

author: Thandie Newton

quote: Knowledge is the consequence of time, and multitude of days are fittest to teach wisdom.
author: Jeremy Collier

quote: Books give not wisdom where none was before. But where some is, there reading makes it more.
author: Elizabeth Hardwick

author: Joseph Story

quote: Wisdom sails with wind and time.
author: John Florio

quote: To avoid entangling alliances has been a maxim of our policy ever since the days of Washington, and its wisdom no one will attempt to dispute.
author: James Buchanan

quote: I don't want to put a pause on the rest of my life I'm really enjoying getting older and the wisdom that comes from that.
author: Rosemarie DeWitt

quote: As an instrument for practical action, law is responsive to the wisdom of its time, which may be wrong, but it carries forward, sometimes in opposition to this wisdom or passion, a memory of received values.

quote: And, if we have any evidence that the wisdom which formed the plan is in the man, we have the very same evidence, that the power which executed it is in him also.
author: Thomas Reid

quote: While many of us never knew Ronald Reagan personally, we felt close to him because we shared his lighthearted sense of humor, admired his uncommon virtue, and were moved by his remarkable wisdom.

quote: What could be more lonely than to be enveloped in silence, to be the last of your people to speak your native tongue, to have no way to pass on the wisdom of the elders, to anticipate the promise of the children. author: Wade Davis

quote: I chose Sony Classics, not just because of their practical experience, not just because of their wisdom in marketing, but mainly because of their integrity.
author: Arthur Cohn

quote: If the highest things are unknowable, then the highest capacity or virtue of man cannot be theoretical wisdom.
author: Leo Strauss

quote: Hatred is corrosive of a person's wisdom and conscience the mentality of enmity can poison a nation's spirit, instigate brutal life and death struggles, destroy a society's tolerance and humanity, and block a nation's progress to freedom and democracy.

quote: Instead of looking at life as a narrowing funnel, we can see it ever widening to choose the things we want to do, to take the wisdom we've learned and create something.

quote: I think in conventional magazine wisdom, you need to have a redesign every decade or so.
author: Timothy White

quote: One reason the human race has such a low opinion of itself is that it gets so much of its wisdom from writers.

quote: In regard of the rich grace and wisdom of his love toward his people for who sees not, but that it is a curse to be unready as these foolish virgins, who were therefore shut out.
author: Thomas Shepard

quote: Knowledge is a process of piling up facts wisdom lies in their simplification.
author: Martin Henry Fischer

quote: The result showed the wisdom of your orders.
author: John Bigelow

quote: I actually think with age comes some level of wisdom.
author: Nina Totenberg

quote: This ceremony and the intellectual aura associated with the Nobel Prizes have grown from the wisdom of a practical chemist who wrote a remarkable will.
author: Stanford Moore

quote: Wisdom denotes the pursuing of the best ends by the best means.
author: Francis Hutcheson

quote: A proverb is the wisdom of many and the wit of one.
author: Lord John Russell

quote: Yale is a crucible in American life for the accommodation of intellectual achievement, of wisdom, of refinement, with the democratic ideals of openness, of social justice and of equal opportunity.
author: Benno C. Schmidt, Jr.

quote: Women always excel men in that sort of wisdom which comes from experience. To be a woman is in itself a terrible experience.
author: H. L. Mencken

quote: Women desire six things: They want their husbands to be brave, wise, rich, generous, obedient to wife, and lively in bed.
author: Geoffrey Chaucer

quote: Clearly older women and especially older women who have led an active life or elder women who successfully maneuver through their own family life have so much to teach us about sharing, patience, and wisdom.
author: Alice Walker

quote: Most women are wise to the fact that lots of men love a cat-fight, and thus go out of their way not to give them one.
author: Julie Burchill

quote: The sum of wisdom is that time is never lost that is devoted to work.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quote: Knowledge comes, but wisdom lingers. It may not be difficult to store up in the mind a vast quantity of facts within a comparatively short time, but the ability to form judgments requires the severe discipline of hard work and the tempering heat of experience and maturity.
author: Calvin Coolidge

quote: Pray thee, spare, thyself at times: for it becomes a wise man sometimes to relax the high pressure of his attention to work.
author: Thomas Aquinas

quote: Now this relaxation of the mind from work consists on playful words or deeds. Therefore it becomes a wise and virtuous man to have recourse to such things at times.
author: Thomas Aquinas

quote: To know how to grow old is the master work of wisdom, and one of the most difficult chapters in the great art of living.
author: Herman Melville

quote: The Supreme Court has ruled that they cannot have a nativity scene in Washington, D.C. This wasn't for any religious reasons. They couldn't find three wise men and a virgin.
author: Jay Leno

quote: Christmas in Bethlehem. The ancient dream: a cold, clear night made brilliant by a glorious star, the smell of incense, shepherds and wise men falling to their knees in adoration of the sweet baby, the incarnation of perfect love.
author: Lucinda Franks

quote: It is a wise father that knows his own child.
author: William Shakespeare

quote: Those who gave thee a body, furnished it with weakness but He who gave thee Soul, armed thee with resolution. Employ it, and thou art wise be wise and thou art happy.
author: Akhenaton

quote: Kisses are a better fate than wisdom.
author: e. e. cummings
